rules.numeric: All PIC 9 / S9 fields (DISPLAY zoned, COMP/BINARY, COMP-3/PACKED-DECIMAL, COMP-5) map to java.math.BigDecimal with the PIC scale. double/float are forbidden.
rules.alphanumeric: PIC X(n)/A(n) map to a fixed-length java.lang.String; bytes are EBCDIC IBM037 (CCSID 037, as declared in zosAsset.yaml) and are decoded/encoded with an explicit charset, padded with spaces.
rules.dates: PIC 9(8) date fields stay raw 8-digit values (layout DDMMYYYY or YYYYMMDD given per field); no automatic java.time conversion.
rules.redefines: REDEFINES are overlays over the same bytes (decode either view, encode only one).
rules.occurs: OCCURS n are fixed arrays; OCCURS m TO n DEPENDING ON c are java.util.List sized by counter c.
rules.edited: Numeric-edited PICs (Z, ., -) are display strings; parse to BigDecimal at the boundary.
rules.binary: COMP/BINARY sizes: 1-4 digits 2 bytes, 5-9 4 bytes, 10-18 8 bytes, big-endian; COMP-5 uses the full binary range.
